name: Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited Class B Subordinate Voting Shares
summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited develops quantum computing technology based on photons together with software, including access to quantum computers through the cloud and tools to program and simulate quantum systems. It offers cloud access to photonic quantum computers via x-series devices and provides Pennylane, a cross-platform Python library for quantum differentiable programming that integrates with machine learning tools.
